index.html.description: Compare Dr. Connor Robertson’s business acquisition, ownership and sales books. Explore individual titles and choose the reading that matches your next decision.
index.html.heading: Find a book for the decision in front of you
index.html.body:
Choose a starting point by the question you want to work through. Each title has a different emphasis; use the overview and chapter topics to check the fit before choosing a format.

Your questionStart withReading focus
How do I approach business ownership?Buying WealthOwnership, acquisition thinking and disciplined research.
Which deal terms need closer attention?Creative AcquisitionsDeal structures, seller objectives and transition questions.
How do I prepare a stalled conversation?The 7 Minute Phone CallCall preparation, listening and an agreed next step.
How can a team rely less on the founder?Built to RunOperating responsibilities, processes and review routines.

For a live acquisition, use the live-deal reading guide to separate the ideas you are exploring from evidence you still need to verify.
